thread.title: UPDATE: Apple co-founder Steve Wozniak hasn't fallen victim to trillion-dollar-market-cap mania

author: morningstar.com
title: UPDATE: Apple co-founder Steve Wozniak hasn't fallen victim to trillion-dollar-market-cap mania
text:
By Tim Rostan, MarketWatch
Company co-founder Steve Wozniak has been aware of the clamor this week over Apple's rapidly accelerating assault on the history books, but, according to a Yahoo Finance report (https://finance.yahoo.com/news/apple-co-founder-steve-wozniak-reacts-1-trillion-milestone-181141220.html), he's been far from fixated on it.
Related: From U.S. Steel's $1 billion market cap to Apple's $1 trillion: a brief history of valuation milestones (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/from-us-steels-1-billion-market-cap-to-apples-1-trillion-a-brief-history-of-valuation-milestones-2018-08-03)
In the words of Wozniak, who founded Apple 42 years ago alongside the legendary Steve Jobs (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/steve-jobs-marketwatchs-ceo-of-the-decade-2011-10-05), remaining with the company full-time till 1985:
Don't miss:Steve Jobs's daughter says it took Bono to get her father to admit naming the Lisa computer after her (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/steve-jobs-daughter-says-he-on-his-deathbed-said-she-smelled-like-a-toilet-2018-08-02)
With its stock(AAPL)closing above $207.04, with 35 cents to spare, Apple on Thursday became the first U.S.-listed company in history to be valued at $1 trillion (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apple-crosses-threshold-needed-for-1-trillion-market-cap-2018-08-02). On Friday, after an initial atock-market retrenchment, Apple went on to build on its exalted valuation, finishing the week with a market cap of nearly $1.0017 trillion (http://bigcharts.marketwatch.com/quickchart/qsymbinfo.asp?sid=609&symb=AAPL&time=8&freq=1).
Read on: Mark Hulbert argues that a trillion-dollar stock-market valuation is no cause for celebration (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/why-a-trillion-dollar-apple-is-nothing-to-celebrate-2018-08-02)
-Tim Rostan; 1808ET
